rationale:
normalize computes finite fuel from the maximum entry depth; normalizeEntries recursively projects entries onto declared fields and reattaches them in declaration order. A nonempty parent collapses only when every direct field is positive. Missing children contribute no entry; known negative children remain negative. An empty class collapses an empty view only at a root already entered by the recursion, with recursion into a child conditioned on a nonempty selected view, so unknown empty-class fields are not invented. This matches the bottom-up rewrite account, its empty-class exception, and whole-type printing convention introduced in given.typing.views. The motivating example and observation definitions precede the algorithm.
